description: Reference published trust policy. Discovery only: this document informs holders what the verifier accepts; the verifier enforces it locally. It deliberately trusts one issuer that is NOT in registry/issuers/ to demonstrate that registry membership is neither necessary nor sufficient for trust. NOTE ON requiredReviewStatuses: this example accepts 'self_attested' as well as 'reviewed' ONLY because no predicate entry in this registry has been independently reviewed yet. A production verifier SHOULD require ["reviewed"] alone; that policy rejects every entry in this registry today, which is the accurate outcome, not a bug. See docs/zkc_predicate_registry_governance.md §2.
